title: Fresh-session fictional bundle capability reuse
description: A fresh Session must discover, activate and use the verified fictional bundle normalizer created by a prior Session.
prompt: Use BUNDLE_FORMAT.md v3 to normalize raw/bundle_08.json into canonical/bundle_08.json. Search for and reuse an exact verified catalog capability when available; do not create a duplicate.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Synthetic bundle fixture

All data is fictional. Never change raw input or BUNDLE_FORMAT.md. Write only canonical/bundle_08.json.
files.BUNDLE_FORMAT.md:
# Canonical fictional bundle format v3

Write exactly schema_version=3; bundle.slug from trimmed lowercase package with whitespace runs changed to one hyphen; bundle.version from trimmed version with one leading v/V removed; target as trimmed uppercase; enabled only when trimmed case-insensitive ship is yes, true, or 1; and features from semicolon splitting, trim/lowercase, non-empty deduplication and alphabetical sorting. Drop every other field.
